017package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.view.freemarker.console;
018
019import java.util.*;
020
021import org.apache.juneau.marshall.collections.*;
022import org.apache.juneau.rest.server.console.*;
023
024/**
025 * A section of a dashboard {@link Rail}.
026 *
027 * <p>
028 * Every section except a {@link CardSection} owns one {@code filter:<key>} topic, set with {@link #publishes(String)}.
029 * The key is the section's id and its bus owner id.  The section publishes a filter-shaped payload
030 * ({@code {schemaVersion:1, viewId, search?, columns?, options?}}) whenever the user changes it.
031 * </p>
032 *
033 * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
034 * <p class='bjava'>
035 *    Rail.<jsm>left</jsm>().sections(
036 *       SearchSection.<jsm>create</jsm>().publishes(Topics.<jsm>filter</jsm>(<js>"search"</js>)),
037 *       Section.<jsm>custom</jsm>(<js>"app.goto"</js>, JsonMap.<jsm>of</jsm>()).publishes(Topics.<jsm>filter</jsm>(<js>"goto"</js>)));
038 * </p>
039 *
040 * @since 10.0.0
041 */
042public abstract class Section {
043
044   String topic;
045   String label;
046
047   Section() {}
048
049   /**
050    * Sets the topic this section owns.
051    *
052    * @param topic A {@code filter:<key>} topic, normally {@code Topics.filter(key)}.  {@code <key>} becomes the section id.
053    * @return This object.
054    */
055   public Section publishes(String topic) {
056      this.topic = topic;
057      return this;
058   }
059
060   /**
061    * Sets the section's legend text.
062    *
063    * @param label The label.
064    * @return This object.
065    */
066   public Section label(String label) {
067      this.label = label;
068      return this;
069   }
070
071   /**
072    * Creates a section implemented in JS by a {@code JuneauDashboard.section.register(name, ...)} section.
073    *
074    * @param name The dotted section name, for example {@code app.goto}.
075    * @param args Arguments handed to the section's {@code mount} as {@code ctx.args}.
076    * @return A new section.
077    */
078   public static Custom custom(String name, JsonMap args) {
079      return new Custom(name, args);
080   }
081
082   /** @return The section id (the key of its topic), or <jk>null</jk> before {@link #publishes(String)} or for a card section. */
083   String id() {
084      return topic == null ? null : topic.substring(topic.indexOf(':') + 1);
085   }
086
087   /** @return The {@code kind} value of the section JSON. */
088   abstract String kind();
089
090   /** @return A human name for messages, for example {@code "range section"}. */
091   String what() {
092      return kind() + " section";
093   }
094
095   /** Adds the kind-specific fields. */
096   abstract void body(Map<String,Object> m);
097
098   /** @return The cards this section adds to the page (only a card section has one). */
099   List<CardSpec> cards() {
100      return List.of();
101   }
102
103   /**
104    * Checks this section, reporting E-77 under {@code dash}.
105    *
106    * @param dash The dashboard id.
107    */
108   void check(String dash) {
109      if (topic == null)
110         throw e77(dash, "a " + what() + " must call publishes(Topics.filter(...))");
111      if (! topic.startsWith("filter:"))
112         throw e77(dash, "section topic '" + topic + "' is not a filter: topic");
113      if (! Topics.ID.matcher(id()).matches())
114         throw e77(dash, "section id '" + id() + "' is not a valid id");
115   }
116
117   /** @return The section JSON. */
118   Map<String,Object> toMap() {
119      var m = new LinkedHashMap<String,Object>();
120      m.put("id", id());
121      m.put("kind", kind());
122      m.put("topic", topic);
123      if (label != null)
124         m.put("label", label);
125      body(m);
126      return m;
127   }
128
129   /**
130    * Builds an E-77 exception.
131    *
132    * @param dash The dashboard id.
133    * @param detail The problem.  A format argument, so a {@code %} in it is harmless.
134    * @return The exception, for the caller to throw.
135    */
136   static IllegalArgumentException e77(String dash, String detail) {
137      return new IllegalArgumentException("E-77: " + String.format(BusWiringValidator.E77, dash, detail));
138   }
139
140   /**
141    * Rejects a bare card as a dashboard member: the shell renders a bare card without a host element to place.
142    *
143    * @param dash The dashboard id.
144    * @param card The panel or card-section card.
145    */
146   static void checkMemberCard(String dash, CardSpec card) {
147      if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(card.toMap().get("bare")))
148         throw e77(dash, "card '" + card.id() + "' is bare; a dashboard member needs a card host");
149   }
150
151   /**
152    * Checks a card the dashboard itself adds to the page: {@link #checkMemberCard}, plus the types that
153    * {@code PageSpec.card} refuses because they have dedicated methods.
154    *
155    * @param dash The dashboard id.
156    * @param card The card.
157    */
158   static void checkOwnedCard(String dash, CardSpec card) {
159      if ("html".equals(card.type()) || "datatables".equals(card.type()))
160         throw e77(dash, "card '" + card.id() + "' has type '" + card.type() + "', which has a dedicated PageSpec method; add it with PageSpec."
161            + ("html".equals(card.type()) ? "html" : "table") + "(...) and use panel(\"" + card.id() + "\")");
162      checkMemberCard(dash, card);
163   }
164
165   /** @return <jk>true</jk> if {@code name} is a dotted extension name (the E-74 shape). */
166   @SuppressWarnings({
167      "java:S2692" // A leading dot is deliberately invalid, so indexOf must be > 0, not >= 0.
168   })
169   static boolean isDottedName(String name) {
170      return name != null && name.indexOf('.') > 0 && BusWiringValidator.EXTENSION_NAME.matcher(name).matches();
171   }
172
173   /**
174    * A section implemented in JS.
175    *
176    * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
177    * <p class='bjava'>
178    *    Section.<jsm>custom</jsm>(<js>"app.goto"</js>, JsonMap.<jsm>of</jsm>()).publishes(Topics.<jsm>filter</jsm>(<js>"goto"</js>));
179    * </p>
180    *
181    * @since 10.0.0
182    */
183   public static final class Custom extends Section {
184
185      private final String name;
186      private final JsonMap args;
187
188      Custom(String name, JsonMap args) {
189         this.name = name;
190         this.args = args == null ? JsonMap.of() : new JsonMap(args);
191      }
192
193      @Override /* Section */
194      public Custom publishes(String topic) {
195         super.publishes(topic);
196         return this;
197      }
198
199      @Override /* Section */
200      public Custom label(String label) {
201         super.label(label);
202         return this;
203      }
204
205      @Override String kind() { return "custom"; }
206
207      @Override void check(String dash) {
208         if (! isDottedName(name))
209            throw e77(dash, "custom section name '" + name + "' is not a dotted extension name");
210         super.check(dash);
211      }
212
213      @Override void body(Map<String,Object> m) {
214         m.put("name", name);
215         m.put("args", args);
216      }
217   }
218}
